parameters.help_en:
The product solution to be integrated.
For more information, see the official documentation: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/product-introduction?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i1
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案
具体详见官方文档 ：https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/product-introduction?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i1
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom unique business identifier on the merchant side, used for subsequent troubleshooting. It supports a combination of letters and digits, with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The MetaInfo environment parameter, which must be obtained through the client SDK
parameters.help_zh: Metainfo环境参数，需要通过客户端SDK获取
parameters.name: meta_info

parameters.help_en:
The type of the identity document.
For the eKYC_PRO and ID_OCR_MAX solutions, see the official documentation: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/certificate-code-table?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_8_2_0.279147abwKAWbr
For the ID_OCR, eKYC, and eKYC_MIN solutions, see the official document type list: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/gnhekqy05ni51m4c?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_3_1_0_0_0.6243244777KoZ7
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型
eKYC_PRO和ID_OCR_MAX方案,详见官方文档 https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/certificate-code-table?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_8_2_0.279147abwKAWbr

ID_OCR,eKYC和eYKC_MIN方案,相见官方文档 证件类型列表 https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/gnhekqy05ni51m4c?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_3_1_0_0_0.6243244777KoZ7
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID or other identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a mobile phone number or email address. Desensitize the value of this field in advance, such as by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The scene code. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 场景码。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the pages to be captured. Separate multiple pages with commas (,). Valid values:
01: The portrait side of the document.
01,02: The portrait and back sides of the document.
When this value is set to 01,02, only Chinese and Vietnamese ID cards are currently supported
parameters.help_zh:
采集页配置，多页使用,连接。取值范围：
01：证件人像面

01,02：证件人像面与背面

此值传入01,02时，目前仅支持中国身份证和越南身份证
parameters.name: pages

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the photo. If you choose to pass the face photo by using FacePictureBase64, check the photo size and do not pass an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 照片Base64编码。如果您选择FacePictureBase64方式传入人脸照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo. It must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 人脸照片地址。公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to crop the image. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 是否裁剪。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable OCR. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启OCR。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: ocr

parameters.help_en: The quality of the face image. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 人脸图片质量。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: id_face_quality

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable document anti-spoofing detection. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用证书防伪检测。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: id_spoof

parameters.help_en: The client-side callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 端侧回调地址
parameters.name: return_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authoritative identity verification. This parameter is currently applicable only to second-generation ID cards in the Chinese mainland and is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启身份权威核验，目前仅适用于中国大陆二代身份证（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: authorize

parameters.help_en:
The photo capture mode for document collection. Valid values:
manual: Manual capture.
auto: Automatic capture. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
证件采集拍照模式。

manual：手动拍照。
auto：自动拍照（默认）
parameters.name: doc_scan_mode

parameters.help_en:
The sequence of document and face verification. Valid values:
DOC_FACE: Document first, then face. This is the default value.
FACE_DOC: Face first, then document.
Note: This parameter is required only when ProductCode is set to KYC_GLOBAL
parameters.help_zh:
支持卡证和人脸顺序编排：

DOC_FACE（默认）
FACE_DOC

注：只有当ProductCode为KYC_GLOBAL需传
parameters.name: product_flow

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for authentication result notifications. The default callback request method is GET, and the callback URL must start with https. After the authentication is completed, the platform calls back this URL and automatically adds the transactionId, passed, and subcode fields
parameters.help_zh: 认证结果的回调通知地址，回调请求方式默认为GET，回调地址必须以https开头。平台在完成认证后会回调该地址，并自动添加transactionId、passed和subcode字段
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The security token used for anti-replay and anti-tampering verification. If this parameter is passed, the CallbackToken field is displayed in the callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 安全Token，用于防重复、防篡改校验。如果传入该参数会在回调地址显示CallbackToken字段
parameters.name: callback_token

parameters.help_en: The language configuration. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh: 语言配置（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: language_config

parameters.help_en:
The pattern that represents different security levels of the authentication flow. Valid values:
01: Normal pattern. This is the default value.
02: Safe mode. This is a relatively strict pattern and is active in high-risk scenarios. This parameter is applicable to IDV products
parameters.help_zh:
代表认证流程不同安全水位的模式，可选值：

01：普通模式（默认）。
02：安全模式，相对严格的模式，可用于高风险场景（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: security_level

parameters.help_en: The custom UI configuration. Convert your custom UI configuration into a JSON string based on the configuration template and pass it through this parameter. For more information, see Customize IDV UI styles (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/idv-kyc-custom-skin?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i60)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义UI配置。根据配置模板，将您自定义的UI配置转换为JSON字符串后，通过该接口传入实现。更多信息，请参见IDV UI样式自定义 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/idv-kyc-custom-skin?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i60)
parameters.name: style_config

parameters.help_en: The experience code
parameters.help_zh: 体验码
parameters.name: experience_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to store a video for evidence. Valid values:
N: No. This is the default value.
Y: Yes. During the authentication process, a video of the user's face scanning process (a 1- to 2-second video file) is captured and returned through the query API.
Because video files are large, the system drops video files when the network is unstable to prioritize the transmission of images required for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要存证视频。

N：不需要（默认）。

Y：认证过程中会同时采集用户的刷脸过程视频（1~2s视频文件），并通过查询接口返回。

因为视频文件较大，当网络不稳定时系统会丢弃视频文件，优先保障认证必要图片传输
parameters.name: doc_video

parameters.help_en:
The type of liveness detection to be performed. Valid values:
LIVENESS: Blink liveness detection. This is the default value.
PHOTINUS_LIVENESS: Dual detection of blink liveness and photinus liveness.

For supported SDK versions, see SDK release notes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/sdk-publishing-record?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i99).
Dual detection of photinus liveness is not supported on the PC client
parameters.help_zh:
要进行活体检测的类型：

LIVENESS（默认）：眨眼动作活体检测。

PHOTINUS_LIVENESS：眨眼动作活体+炫彩活体双重检测。


支持集成的SDK版本，请参见SDK发布记录 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/sdk-publishing-record?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i99)。
PC端不支持炫彩活体双重检测
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en:
The custom threshold mode for OCR quality detection. Valid values:
0: Standard mode.
1: Strict mode.
2: Loose mode.
3: Disable quality detection. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
自定义OCR质量检测阈值模式：
0：标准模式
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the album upload entry during the document OCR recognition phase. Valid values:
1: Display. This is the default value.
0: Do not display
parameters.help_zh:
证件OCR识别环节，是否展示相册上传入口：

1：展示（默认）

0：不展示
parameters.name: show_album_icon

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the recognition result page during the document OCR recognition phase. Valid values:
1: Display. This is the default value.
0: Do not display
parameters.help_zh:
证件OCR识别环节，是否展示识别结果页：

1：展示（默认）

0：不展示
parameters.name: show_ocr_result

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the guide page. Valid values:
1: Display. This is the default value.
0: Do not display
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示引导页面开关：

1：展示（默认）

0：不展示
parameters.name: show_guide_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow fallback processing when compatibility issues occur during mobile H5 authentication. Valid values:
url: Fallback supported. This is the default value. The page displays the authentication URL, and the user can copy the URL to open it or switch browsers to continue authentication.
keep: Fallback not supported. The system directly returns the error cause and ends the authentication process.

This switch is not supported on PCs.
If your business scenario involves completing authentication in a web page embedded in an app, we recommend that you set this parameter to keep to disable URL fallback
parameters.help_zh:
当移动端H5方式认证出现兼容性问题时，是否允许展示降级的处理方式。

url（默认）：支持降级。页面展示认证URL，用户可复制URL打开或者切换浏览器继续认证。

keep：不支持降级。直接返回错误原因，并结束认证流程。



PC端不支持此开关。
若业务应用场景为App内嵌网页完成认证，建议此参数设置为keep，不允许降级URL
parameters.name: procedure_priority

parameters.help_en:
<warning>This feature is not supported by the Web SDK. To use this feature, refer to the App SDK integration guide.</warning>
Specifies whether to enable strict face quality detection. Valid values:
Y: Enable. This is the default value.
N: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
<warning>该功能Web SDK暂不支持，如需使用请参考App SDK接入。</warning>

是否开启人脸严格质量检测：
Y：开启（默认）
N：不开启
parameters.name: app_quality_check

parameters.help_en: The custom configuration passed by the customer to specify whether to capture more pages
parameters.help_zh: 客户自定义传入是否要采集更多页面
parameters.name: doc_page_config

parameters.help_en:
The input source of the MRTD verification parameter. This parameter is required to decrypt information when NFC reads the document chip information. Valid values:
0: User input.
1: OCR reading.
2: API input
parameters.help_zh:
MRTD校验参数输入来源。NFC读取证件芯片信息时依赖该参数解密信息。

0：用户输入

1：ocr读取

2：接口传入
parameters.name: mrtd_input

parameters.help_en:
The document number.
This parameter is required when MRTDInput is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
证件号

MRTDInput = 2时，必传
parameters.name: document_number

parameters.help_en:
The date of birth on the document, in the format of YYMMDD (6 digits).
This parameter is required when MRTDInput is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
证件上的出生日期，格式为 YYMMDD（6 位数字）。

MRTDInput = 2时，必传
parameters.name: date_of_birth

parameters.help_en:
The expiration date on the document, in the format of YYMMDD (6 digits).
This parameter is required when MRTDInput is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
证件上的有效期截止日期，格式为 YYMMDD（6 位数字）。

MRTDInput = 2时，必传
parameters.name: date_of_expiry

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable NFC verification when DocType is set to 01000000 (global passport). Valid values:
Y: Enable.
N: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
当DocType=01000000（全球护照）时，可选是否启用NFC验证。
Y（启用）
N（不启用）
parameters.name: use_nfc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the adaptive color-changing window border. Valid values:
Y: Enable.
N: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自适应变色窗口边框
Y：开启
N：不开启
parameters.name: chameleon_frame_enable

parameters.help_en: The document number of the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户的证件号码
parameters.name: doc_no

parameters.help_en: The real name of the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户的真实姓名
parameters.name: doc_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the recognition result page is editable during the document OCR recognition phase. Valid values:
0: Not editable.
1: Editable. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
证件OCR识别环节，识别结果页是否可编辑：

0：不可编辑

1（默认）：可编辑
parameters.name: edit_ocr_result

parameters.help_en: The type of verification
parameters.help_zh: 验证的类型
parameters.name: verify_model

parameters.help_en: The face databases to be compared
parameters.help_zh: 需要比对的人脸库
parameters.name: face_group_codes

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the portrait photo
parameters.help_zh: 人像照片Base64编码
parameters.name: target_face_picture

parameters.help_en: The URL of the portrait photo. It must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 人像图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: target_face_picture_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic registration
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动注册
parameters.name: auto_registration

parameters.help_en: The face database for registration
parameters.help_zh: 注册人脸库
parameters.name: face_register_group_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to save the face picture
parameters.help_zh: 是否保存人脸图片
parameters.name: save_face_picture

parameters.help_en: The threshold for face verification
parameters.help_zh: 人脸验证阈值
parameters.name: face_verify_threshold

parameters.help_en: The number of duplicate faces to be returned
parameters.help_zh: 返回重复人脸数量
parameters.name: return_faces

parameters.help_en:
The Indonesian phone number. The format must be verified, starting with +62 followed by 9 to 11 digits. This field takes effect only when Authorize is set to T.

This field is required only when the Indonesian data source is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
传入印度尼西亚电话号码，需校验格式（以+62开头，后接9-11位数字），此字段仅在Authorize=T时生效。


该字段仅在开启印尼数据源时必传
parameters.name: mobile

parameters.help_en:
The Indonesian email address. This field takes effect only when Authorize is set to T.

This field is required only when the Indonesian data source is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
传入印度尼西亚邮箱，此字段仅在Authorize=T时生效。


该字段仅在开启印尼数据源时必传
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The execution sequence of liveness detection actions in TemplateConfig.
This parameter is required when Model is set to TEMPLATE. Valid values:
Seq: Execute from left to right in the sequence configured in TemplateConfig.
Ran: Execute in a random order. If you select this option, TemplateConfig must be configured with more than one action
parameters.help_zh:
TemplateConfig活体检测动作执行顺序。
当 Model 为 TEMPLATE 时，需传入此参数。

Seq：按TemplateConfig配置的顺序从左至右执行。
Ran ：随机乱序执行，选择此项时，TemplateConfig必须配置多于1个动作
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom action pool configuration for liveness detection.
This parameter is required when Model is set to TEMPLATE.
Configuration rules: Separate multiple action codes with commas (,). Best Practices: Include at least one frontal face action (such as blinking) and keep the total number of actions to a maximum of 3.
Action code lookup table:

Blink: 01
Open Mouth: 02
Shake Head Left: 03
Shake Head Right: 04
Move Farther: 05
Move Closer: 06
Photinus: 07
parameters.help_zh:
活体检测自定义动作池配置。
当 Model 为 TEMPLATE 时，需传入此参数。
配置规则：多个动作代码使用英文逗号分隔。最佳实践：建议包含至少一个正脸动作（如眨眼），且总数不超过 3 个。
动作代码表：

眨眼（Blink）：01
张嘴（Open Mouth）：02
左摇头（Shake Head Left）：03
右摇头（Shake Head Right）：04
拉远摄像头（Move Farther）：05
拉近摄像头（Move Closer）：06
炫彩检测（Photinus）：07
parameters.name: template_config

parameters.help_en:
The number of actions randomly selected from TemplateConfig.
This parameter takes effect only when TemplateType is set to Ran.
Validation rules:
The value must be greater than 1 and less than or equal to the total number of actions configured in TemplateConfig. If this parameter is not passed, the default value is equal to the total number of actions in TemplateConfig
parameters.help_zh:
从TemplateConfig中随机抽取的动作数量。
仅当 TemplateType 为 Ran 时生效。

-校验规则：
数值必须大于1。数值小于等于 TemplateConfig 中配置的动作总数。若不传，默认等于 TemplateConfig 中的动作总数
parameters.name: template_ran_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return additional standardized format fields for OCR recognition. Valid values:
0: No. This is the default value.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要额外返回OCR识别标准化格式字段：

0：否 (默认)

1：是
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return additional face attribute information. Valid values: N: Do not return. This is the default value. Y: Return. The result is located in Result.ExtFaceInfo.FaceAttributeInfo
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回额外的人脸属性信息。N：不返回（默认）；Y：返回，结果位于 Result.ExtFaceInfo.FaceAttributeInfo
parameters.name: face_attribute_check

parameters.help_en: The automatic document page classification configuration. This parameter takes effect only when DocType is set to a country or region code. You can specify the pages to be captured based on the specific document type code. For documents that are not configured, only the front side is captured
parameters.help_zh: 自动证件页分类配置。仅当 DocType 为国家或地区编码时生效，可按具体证件类型编码指定采集页；未配置的证件仅采集正面
parameters.name: auto_doc_page_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite the original face with the current face if MerchantUserId already exists during automatic registration. Valid values: Y: Overwrite. N: Do not overwrite and return that the UserId already exists
parameters.help_zh: 自动入库时若 MerchantUserId 已存在，是否使用本次人脸覆盖原有人脸。Y：覆盖；N：不覆盖并返回 UserId 已存在
parameters.name: update_face_if_user_exists

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to intercept the request when multiple faces are detected on the terminal. Valid values:
Y: Intercept. The client prompts the user to scan their face again.
N: Do not intercept. This is the default value. The system selects the largest face in the face scanning frame and sends it to the server for security detection
parameters.help_zh:
终端检测到多人脸时是否拦截，取值：

Y：拦截，客户端提示需要重新刷脸。
N（默认）：不拦截，取刷脸画面中的最大脸发送服务端进行安全检测
parameters.name: need_multi_face_check

Protocol.description_en:
The standard encryption protocol for authentication.

This field is required when integrating H5 web pages by using an embedded iframe
Protocol.description_zh:
认证标准加密协议。

H5网页接入，选择iframe内嵌集成时依赖该字段
